audience: HR and people teams that run goals, check-ins and recognition in Betterworks

useCases.title: Find goals at risk this quarter
useCases.text: List goals filtered by owner, group, risk or last update, then open one goal to read its progress and milestones.

useCases.title: Read recognitions for one person
useCases.text: List recognitions filtered by user, hashtag or date range, and read the user profile of the person.

useCases.title: Find an employee and their team
useCases.text: Search employees by name or email, then read the profile and the team of one employee.

useCases.title: Create a goal and post a check-in
useCases.text: Create a goal for one user with dates and a progress type. Then post a check-in with a new progress value.

useCases.title: Update fields of a goal
useCases.text: Change the fields you send on an existing goal.

useCases.title: Run an organization report
useCases.text: Start a report run for a date range, then read its result once the vendor finishes it.
